body.heading: Bio calcium from the world's eggshells
body.formula_caption: Calcium carbonate, about 95% of eggshell by mass{Verify}
body.lead: Ecoshell develops eggshell-derived materials for plastic reduction and supports customers through masterbatches, finished products and manufacturing services.
body.body: We clean, mill and treat eggshell into a fine bio-calcium powder, then compound it into masterbatches that replace part of the polymer in a plastic product.

body.heading: How it is made and how it is used

items.title: Collect
items.text: Eggshell is recovered from egg-breaking plants and food processors.

items.title: Clean and mill
items.text: Shells are cleaned, membranes removed and milled into fine bio calcium.

items.title: Compound
items.text: The powder is compounded into masterbatch with a carrier resin.

items.title: Mould or form
items.text: You add it at the hopper and run your normal process.

name: Sustainability
title: Sustainability
description: Sustainability: Ecoshell eggshell-derived materials for plastic reduction.

body.title: Plastic reduction you can measure
body.subtitle: Our stance is simple: every environmental claim we make sits next to the test or study that supports it.

body.heading: Practical, measured, specific
body.lead: We reduce the fossil plastic in everyday products by replacing part of it with a mineral that would otherwise be waste.
body.body: We do not claim products are "zero impact" or "100% sustainable". We publish the baseline, the percentage by mass and the tested formulation for each grade, and we keep LCA results tied to their study boundary and date.

body.subtitle: We turn one of the world's largest unused food-waste streams into materials that put less plastic into everyday products.

body.heading: Our story
body.lead: Ecoshell started with a simple observation: eggshells are one of the largest unused waste streams in the world.
body.body: We found a way to turn that waste into a material that is economical, meets recycling goals, and works as a drop-in for manufacturers. Today we work with converters, brands and manufacturing partners across [markets].
